subject.title: feat(agents): per-agent outbound A2A allowlist override

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.list[].tools.agentToAgent.allow` as the outbound-only per-agent A2A authorization contract now, or defer it to the broader session-visibility permission model?
rationale: This PR adds a new core config and SDK-visible authorization surface for cross-agent session tools, so the final contract shape is a maintainer security/product decision rather than only a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Normalize exact allow entries, rebase, and land the narrow outbound-only contract while leaving broader per-capability session visibility to the existing follow-up issues.

options.title: Defer to broader design
options.body: Pause this PR and resolve per-agent A2A together with the broader permission-model work tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/59149 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48785.

options.title: Redesign the contract first
options.body: Ask for a maintainer design on outbound-only versus bidirectional or receiver-side semantics before accepting any new config surface.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Normalize exact allow entries, rebase, and land the narrow outbound-only contract while leaving broader per-capability session visibility to the existing follow-up issues.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the clearest recent source-history tie to the touched session-visibility, session-tool, config-schema, and docs surfaces.
